tasks.prompt: From this meeting note, list only the action items that have an explicit deadline, with their owner: 'Ravi will send the deck before Thursday. Someone should book the venue at some point. Lena needs to confirm the caterer by end of week. We should all review the budget eventually. Tom is going to call the printer tomorrow morning.' tasks.reference: A good answer includes exactly the three items with explicit deadlines: Ravi (send the deck, before Thursday), Lena (confirm the caterer, by end of week), and Tom (call the printer, tomorrow morning). It should EXCLUDE the two items with no explicit deadline (booking the venue 'at some point', reviewing the budget 'eventually').
